reviews.title: No support
reviews.text: I have to use this app for work and the last 8 months only a few of my workouts are showing up for work.  I have contacted support twice, but no help.  At least one issue I have discovered, is my workout is not showing up if my watch died before I end the workout.  Considering this is the only app running on my watch, I also wonder if it is the reason my watch is suddenly dying in just 2 hours.

reviews.title: Apple watch & missing activities
reviews.text:
I have used this app for years and love it.  It would totally be a five out of five if they can fix the Apple Watch issue.  If I turn on the app on my phone, it will go onto my watch if I turn it on on the watch, it doesn’t go onto the phone therefore I miss things while I’m working out.

Also, since I have back issues, I like to walk up and down in the pool… so I don’t get steps for this, but I don’t get real activity from the pool either

Otherwise, it does a great job with yardwork, hiking walking, and anything else I needed to do!!!

reviews.title: So simple yet thorough- GET IT!
reviews.text: I’ve been using this for probably ten years. It still has my old comments in here. I can look back and see, “oh let’s not do that. I see that in 2021, we didn’t like that trail.” Plus it tracks EVERYTHING! Well, it doesn’t have a specific “gardening” workout, dang it! But you can make your own. I love this app. It’s all I need. reviews.title: Recent Negative Changes
reviews.text: I’m a big fan of the app and have had it for a decade. I pay for the app so I have all the functionality, and to support the platform, so I’m pretty frustrated that the last few updates have added popup ads and notification ads. Ads are horrible and I do not want them. I pay for this app. Why are you forcing ads for paying customers? I quit watching television in 2011 because I really hate ads everywhere. Please stop.
